description: This file is a Perl script implementing optimized x86 assembly routines for GHASH operations used in cryptography, specifically for the OpenSSL project. It includes code paths for vanilla x86 and SSE, with detailed comments on performance and implementation details.

methods.name: clmul64x64_T2
methods.description: Performs 64x64 carry-less multiplication with minimal register pressure, used in GHASH implementation.

methods.name: clmul64x64_T3
methods.description: Alternative 64x64 carry-less multiplication routine with better ILP, used in GHASH implementation.

methods.name: reduction_alg9
methods.description: Performs polynomial reduction in GF(2^128) optimized for the 'Algorithm 9' method, used in GHASH.
